jobs.title: Program Manager (Data Center Services)
jobs.description:
As a Program Manager, you will manage and oversee all aspects of a customer program to ensure all projects are completed on-time and within budget. Each program will have multiple concurrent projects and you are responsible for managing scope, cost, schedule, internal staffing and outside vendors for each project. You will prepare reports for upper management and customer stakeholders regarding project status as well as contribute to moderately complex aspects of a project. Your work is generally independent and collaborative in nature.

Responsibilities:

- Directs and manages programs and possibly project managers that may include multiple large and complex project development from beginning to end.

- Defines and refines program and project scope, goals, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to support business goals in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.

- Develops full-scale project plans and associated communications documents to identify and manage project timeline, dependencies, and critical path using appropriate tools.

- Sets, manages, and communicates program and project expectations to team members and stakeholders.

- Liaise with program and project stakeholders on an on-going basis.

- Estimates resources, participants, and preferred partner vendors needed to achieve program goals.

- Functions as leader for continuous improvement events and develops employees to be self-sufficient in continuous improvement tools.

- Aligns activities with corporate goals around safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

- Performs root cause analysis on gaps, identifies waste, and works with leadership to drive sustainable corrective action.

- Drafts and submits budget proposals, and recommends subsequent budget changes.

- Negotiates with other department managers for acquisition of required personnel.

- Determines and assesses need for additional staff or consultants and makes appropriate staffing adjustments during project cycle.

- Delegates tasks and responsibilities to subordinate Project Managers and personnel.

- Identifies and resolves issues and conflicts within project teams.

- Develops and delivers progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.

- Manages changes in project scope, identifies potential concerns, and devises contingency plans.

- Confers with customers on programs performance and evaluate areas for improvement and expanded services.

- Administers on-site human resource activities as required.

- Monitors programs effectiveness and prepares monthly reports, including cost, performance, service quality and improvements.

- Analyzes supplier performance and makes recommendations on new agreements.

- Advises and trains employees on methods and use of equipment in handling, storing, maintaining and delivering of stock material.

- Reviews program performance metrics with site, including inventory turns, delivery, savings and stockroom fill rates, cost savings and areas for improvement.

- Monitors account receivables and takes action.

- Ensures proper implementation, participates in review to verify effectiveness, and identifies opportunities for improvement of quality systems.

- Responds to audit findings and implements appropriate actions.

- Coordinates vendor information sharing activities with customer, including new product launch, value-added and cost savings initiatives.

Qualifications:

- Bachelors’ Degree required.

- 5 years required; 7 years preferred of related experience.

- 2 years of program management and 5 years of project management experience in directing work in a large-scale program and project management capacity, including all aspects of process development and execution highly preferred.

- Prior project management experience with deployment and commissioning of liquid-cooled rack systems and supporting infrastructure projects, including HVAC, heat exchangers, chillers, liquid cooled piping installation preferred.

- Prior experience with managing people in a matrixed environment and using/developing processes to achieve objectives preferred.

- Excellent computer skills: Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Monday.com, Copilot, Project highly preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.

- Strong persuasion and skills.

- Strong computer skills.

- Strong math and analytical skills.

- Organized and detail oriented.

- Travel up to 20%.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Program Management
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and business-focused Senior Specialist – Program Management to join the CSS Program Risk Management Team. This role is responsible for supporting complex program operations through pricing administration, reporting, BOM management, profitability analysis, and the development of tools that enable customer-facing teams to manage programs more effectively. The position plays a critical role in driving pricing accuracy, improving data transparency, identifying margin and contract risks, and supporting decisions that strengthen profitability across key program accounts. This individual will work closely with Program Management, Customer Service, Procurement, Finance, vendors, and customer teams to ensure program data, pricing, and reporting are accurate, actionable, and aligned with contractual and business objectives.

Responsibilities:

- Pricing Administration and Profitability Management

- Own and maintain cost and pricing data across assigned programs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with contractual requirements.

-  Analyze pricing, cost changes, supplier quotes, and margin trends to identify risks, opportunities, and actions needed to protect or improve program profitability.

- Provide quarterly pricing support for contract business, validate Special Pricing Agreement expirations, and coordinate customer quotations by partnering with vendors and internal program teams.

- Monitor and safeguard contractual pricing terms while proactively escalating pricing discrepancies, margin concerns, and compliance risks.

- Reporting, Analytics, and Decision Support

- Develop, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad hoc reporting using Microsoft Access, Power BI, Excel, and other business tools to support internal teams, external customers, and program leadership.

-  Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that support program tracking, risk analysis, profitability reviews, and operational decision-making.

- Maintain strong data integrity standards and continuously improve reporting processes to increase accuracy, consistency, and visibility across programs.

- Tool Creation and Process Improvement

-  Create and improve tools, templates, dashboards, and data models that help customer service, program management, procurement, and customer teams better manage program activity.

- Identify process gaps, reporting inefficiencies, and manual workarounds, then design practical solutions that improve team productivity and reduce risk.

-  Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and convert them into scalable tools and reporting solutions.

-  Bill of Material (BOM) Management

-  Manage item creation, maintenance, and updates for multiple program BOMs to ensure materials, pricing, and program requirements remain aligned.

-  Coordinate with Customer Service, Procurement, Program Management, vendors, and customer teams to resolve data discrepancies and support accurate material planning.

- Support BOM governance by ensuring changes are properly reviewed, documented, and reflected across reporting and program tools.

Qualifications:

-  High School Degree or equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

-  2+ years of experience in program management, pricing administration, reporting, analytics, contract support, or a related business operations function.

-  Demonstrated ability to analyze pricing, cost, margin, and program data to identify business risks and profitability opportunities.

- Advanced computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Access, and Power BI.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex data clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, interpersonal, and persuasion skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and attention to detail.

#LI-RS

jobs.title: Specialist - Program Management
jobs.description:
As a Specialist - Program Management, you will be responsible for the coordination of assigned programs.  You will support and resolve issues for customers, coordinates sourcing, quotations, and contract compliance activities.  You will also Specialist provide warehouse logistics tracking to ensure assigned programs exceed customer expectations.

Responsibilities:

- Quotes materials, coordinating engineering, purchasing on the customer side, vendors, and outside sales to ensure all are aligned.

- Provides support for sourcing of material, coordinating sales and operations teams.

- Updates customer owned inventory, tracking to ensure shipment before new inventory is brought in.

- Interfaces with customers, internal logistics team, and freight companies for timely shipment of pallet positions.

- Provides information for quarterly pricing for contract business, validate expiration of SPA’s for program business, coordinating quotation to customers by working with vendors and internal program management team.

- Contacts customers on invoice issues, researching to reconcile errors.

- Manages batches of orders by ensuring customer data is received in internal systems, and accurate drops to warehouse for shipping.

- Post order support to customer by expediting material with vendors to ensure on time delivery of product.

- Coordination with warehouse leaders for assigned program business to ensure shipments are out the door timely.

- Contributes ideas for improving departmental efficiency.

Qualifications:

- High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

- 2-4 years program management experience or related experience in supporting large programs or projects.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.

- Strong persuasion skills.

- Strong computer skills.

- Strong math and analytical skills.
